definition: Ocean — in Spandasandoha, the metaphor for Śiva's self-established nature: like an ocean remaining unmoved (avicala) even as world-waves (viśvakallola) arise within it. The ocean is not disturbed by its waves; Śiva is not disturbed by the world.

sources.claim: samudra iva viśvakallolaprasare'pi avicalatsvasvarūpāvasthānaḥ (like an ocean remaining unmoved even as world-waves arise)

translations.note: Literal 'ocean'; the metaphor is the point — unmoved by waves.
